criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Frames 1, 7 and 8 come close to the 10. Four weak frames. Frame 6, the turn, shows flies as chains of capsules with bead eyes, a hard vertical glass seam and a muddy left half. Frame 4's page stands upright on a flat unlit wall. Frame 5's vial is cut by the right edge and its plug merges into a facade, trees are cards with no contact, no shadow across the tapes. Frame 3's dek ends just above the bezel and the vial is a small prop. Frame 9 has an unexplained bright slab at the upper right. Vial walls show wavy vertical streaks on 1, 5, 7, 8. Frame 7's gene off label is outside the safe zone.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One hero, one accent, one key and grade, both declared devices work. The 4 to 5 cut is undeclared, the hero shrinks to a prop in the room frames, frame 6 sits outside both worlds.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every string carries claim ids that hold it, every encoding traces. Frame 9's 'Texome takes' is firmer than c39, the caption opener is an inference no quote states.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who, where, how and what to do. The stake for the reader stays general.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe, frame 5 a well-placed counter-image, 7 the payoff. Frame 4's sub-count could compress, frame 6's weakness softens the turn.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and honest with strong lines. Frame 8's dek is flat paper prose and 'That is not its accuracy.' is stiff. Little Texan voice.

criteria.why: Fresh subject. goldenHour as on no. 37, green accent after no. 39, canvas bars on a kit monitor repeat no. 35, cover move repeats nos. 37 and 39.
